topic: Myelination: speeding up neural signal transmission
caption: Did you know your brain has a 'speed boost' mechanism? 🚀 Myelination is the process of forming a myelin sheath around neurons, speeding up neural signal transmission by up to 300% 📈! 💡 Learn how this affects your daily life.
